query.text: 请帮我照看门口的狗狗，有需要帮助或异常的情况及时通知我。
query.text_en: Please help me look after the dog at the door, and notify me in time if it needs help or if there is any abnormal situation.

annotation.text_zh: 狗狗在按门铃，它想进屋了。
annotation.text_en: The dog is ringing the doorbell to come inside.
The dog rang the doorbell again.

assistant_role_basis: 按任务归类，不代表可从画面确认设备硬件
